ga4.name: Google Analytics 4
ads.name: Google Ads
sheets.name: Google Sheets இறக்குமதி
showcaseSub: மாதிரி தரவு மட்டும்: Google-இலிருந்து எதுவும் படிக்கப்படவில்லை.
ads.gate: Google Ads developer token (basic access) தேவை
ads.gateSub: Google basic access வழங்கும் வரை, Google Ads சோதனைக் கணக்குகளை மட்டுமே படிக்க முடியும்.
ga4.pickHelp: Only properties your Google account can read are listed. Daily sessions, users and key events are loaded from the report, by channel, source / medium, device, city, landing page and campaign.
ga4.thresholded: Google hid some rows to protect privacy (data thresholds). Totals can be lower than in Analytics.
ga4.otherRow: Google grouped rare combinations into an (other) row because the report was too large.
ads.pickHelp: Client accounts your Google login can read. A manager account is not listed itself: pick one of its clients.
ads.currencyNote: Ads accounts not in INR need a conversion rate in the connection settings; rows without one are skipped, never converted with a guess.
ads.conversionsNote: Conversions are rounded to whole numbers. Google restates recent days, so the last 7 days are reloaded every run.
sheets.pickHelp: Paste the spreadsheet link and a range such as A1:F500 or a tab name followed by !A1:F500. The first row is the header.
sheets.mapHelp: Each column goes to a CRM field or is ignored. Rows are checked and duplicates (email, phone, or name and city) are found before anything is saved.
sheets.resyncHelp: Reads the same range each day. Duplicates are skipped or updated, never doubled.
err.token_rejected: Google rejected the access. Reconnect to continue.
err.not_configured: The Google app is not configured on this deployment
err.not_available: This item is not available to your Google account
err.needs_developer_token: Google Ads developer token is not approved for this account yet (needs basic access)
err.bad_spreadsheet: That is not a Google Sheets link or id
err.bad_range: That is not a valid range. Use a form like A1:F500, or a tab name followed by !A1:F500
err.bad_object: Choose what to import: leads, contacts or accounts
err.empty: The range has no data rows
err.too_many_rows: The range has more rows than one import allows (10,000)
err.too_many_columns: The range has more columns than one import allows (60)
err.mapping_incomplete: Map the required fields first (a name, and an email or phone for leads)
reconnect: Google access was revoked or expired. Reconnect to resume syncing.
